case: PostgreSQL float8[] file exports and SQL replay
contract: The array contains an adjacent double, negative zero, the minimum subnormal, NaN, positive and negative Infinity, and SQL NULL.
JSON, CSV, XML, HTML, Markdown and XLSX exports preserve the driver text as text, with each format's escaping rules.

SQL export replay preserves the PostgreSQL double precision[] type, array_to_json value semantics and exact array_send bytes. Separate float8send assertions pin the adjacent value, negative-zero sign bit and minimum-subnormal bits.

focused_docker_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration array_contract::value_contract_float8_array_file_exports_preserve_bits -- --ignored --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1

remaining: Other PostgreSQL array families, engine/type/consumer/configuration combinations and installed application re-imports remain open in B3.
